Production and propagation of sound: Sound comes from vibrations and needs a medium. In air it is a longitudinal wave of compressions and rarefactions.
Characteristics of sound waves: Loudness depends on amplitude, pitch on frequency. T = 1/f and v = f × λ.
Speed of sound, reflection and echo: Speed: solids > liquids > gases. An echo needs about 17 m in air; d = v × t / 2.
Human ear, hearing range, ultrasound and: Human range is 20 Hz to 20 kHz. Ultrasound is used in SONAR, imaging and by bats.
